name: input
title: Input
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input. 2px ink line that thickens to 3px on focus, italic placeholder, fine line when read-only, dashed line + light tone when disabled, and an error look on aria-invalid (stamp red, serrated bottom edge, "!" mark). Sizes via inputSize: sm, default, lg.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/input". It wraps your own components/ui/input, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A 2px ink line that thickens on focus; serrated with a “!” on error.
meta.usage:
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/manga/input"

<Input placeholder="Pen name" />
<Input aria-invalid defaultValue="reader@" />
